story_candidates.angle: A short, dated list of side events around Web Summit whose organisers have said, on their own pages, that Wednesday's event is postponed, cancelled, moved to Thursday or online, so readers with plans know to check; side events are not Web Summit's own.
story_candidates.note: For journalist (summit desk). Ready; time-sensitive (today). Conditions: list only events whose organiser's own page you re-read, each with the page, the wording the organiser uses (quote the title or sentence) and the time read; say pages change and readers should check each organiser; side events are run by their organisers, not by Web Summit; the Elevon and 'Cancelled: update below' wording as the pages give it (read the 'update' of the AltaIR page: the curator did not); you may add further events from lisbontechfringe.com only after reading their organiser pages (a pointer, never the citation), and never an 'unknown' row; no contact details, no attendee names, no hosts' personal details (event pages show host and guest names: leave them out); do not say why an event changed unless the page does.
